title: The Advantage of being our Marketing Agent
description: We invite you to be a part of our growing community that values authenticity, wellness, and business opportunity to build sustainability income.

contents.title: 31% Introducer Bonus (Instant)
contents.description: Earn 31% by referring new agent or customers buy any of package that we provided base on point value each package.

contents.title: 10-12% Group Sales Bonus (Daily)
contents.description: Earn up to 12% bonus from your group sales base on point value each package.

contents.title: 30% Max Leadership Bonus (Daily)
contents.description: Earn 5%-10% from each level by your agent group sales bonus income (max 5 level by term & condition)

contents.title: $0.50 ~ $5.00 Royalty Bonus (Monthly)
contents.description: Earn $0.50 each level by every repeat sales 'Maintain account' from customers (max 10 level by term & condition)

contents.title: Redemption Point (Achieved Items)
contents.description: Collect redemption point from successful group sales point value and redeem point for cash or items provided by company.
